Subject: Draft MAP + proposed signoff cadence and Day 1 target

Hi Santiago / Natalie —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation I attached a concise mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed signoff cadence so your procurement and legal teams can see the gating timeline. Key points:

- Evaluation window: 2 weeks (pilot config + three success prompts) starting when we receive the signed SOW.
- Exec endorsement: Orion VP of Ops to give formal go/no-go by end of the eval window.
- Signing: we propose a DocuSign route with staggered signer windows — procurement first, then business execs.
- Day 1 start: aiming for 2026-03-15 if signatures are complete by 2026-03-05.

I've attached MAP_Orion_v3.xlsx (milestones + owners), SOW_Redwood_v1.2.pdf, and a quick signature-window-grid.csv to help align calendars.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Procurement confirms preferred signer list + any redlines by Tue 02/24.
2) Redwood to prepare final SOW for e-sign by Wed 02/25.
3) Schedule a 30m alignment call (stakeholders only) to lock the go/no-go criteria on Mon 02/23 — I can host.

Open to alternate dates but the 03/15 start is what we can guarantee for onboarding & reserved capacity.

Thanks — laura

--
